verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Base44 supports editing code externally via GitHub sync, CLI eject/download, or bringing your own agent to the sandbox, but there is no documentation of an in-builder source code editor where a developer can view/edit the generated code directly inside the app builder UI. missing for 10: any mention of an in-app/in-builder code editor or code view, first-party or hands-on confirmation of direct in-builder code editing.
